stem:
The table represents a relationship between x and y.

|  x  |  y  |
|-----|-----|
|  5  | 22  |
| 10  | 27  |
| 15  | 32  |
| 20  | 37  |

The relationship between the x-values and y-values creates a pattern that is —

options.label: A
options.text: additive, because each x-value increases by 5

options.label: B
options.text: additive, because each y-value is determined by adding 17 to the corresponding x-value

options.label: C
options.text: multiplicative, because each y-value is determined by multiplying the corresponding x-value by 17

options.label: D
options.text: multiplicative, because each x-value is a multiple of 5

visual_elements:
table with headers 'x' and 'y'
values under x: 5, 10, 15, 20
values under y: 22, 27, 32, 37
